title: Identity-generator coherence for nested opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $V\subseteq U\subseteq X$ opens [def-weil-open-immersion], and $i:V\to U$ their inclusion. Write $A_W,k_W$ for the explicit free sheaves and identity-generator maps of [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map], $a:A_V\to A_U$ for the free-sheaf map of the inclusion, and $c:j_V^*\simeq i^*j_U^*$ for the specified inverse-image composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then $c_{A_U}\circ j_V^*(a)\circ k_V=i^*(k_U)\circ z_i^{-1}$, where $z_i:i^*\mathbb Z_U\simeq\mathbb Z_V$ is the specified constant-sheaf pullback comparison. This is an equality of sheaf morphisms, independent of any coefficient sheaf or cohomological degree.

source.place: Lemma cohomology-of-open, proof by restriction of an injective resolution; free-representable/Yoneda and constant-sheaf adjunctions. Explicit identity-generator construction and unit compatibility supplied by F2.

proof.text: Apply the constant-sheaf adjunction at the terminal object of V. The free-sheaf map a sends the identity generator of V to the inclusion generator V to U, by naturality of free abelian groups and sheafification.

Use open_restriction_pullback_unit with g=U.ι and W=V. Since V is contained in U, the open fibre product V times_X U identifies with V. Cancel the identity unit and its comparison. The composition-unit equation identifies successive restriction comparisons with the direct comparison for V. The constant pullback comparison sends 1 to 1. Thus both morphisms classify the same inclusion generator. The adjunction bijection proves equality, including equal opens and the empty open.
